en: Oh, good. You came.

What's wrong, Kaito?
Why did you call me out here all of a sudden?

See, since I was chosen as an astronaut 
trainee, I've trained every day, but...

I haven't done any training here at all.
At this rate, I'll get all weak, so...
Join me, Shuichi.
What? Why me?

Doesn't matter, let's get started!
Take off your coat!
Wait, why—!?
Instead of complaining, just do 50 push-ups!

<CLT=cltMIND>I don't know how it happened,
but before I knew it...

<CLT=cltMIND>I was doing push-ups with Kaito in the
courtyard in the middle of the night.

*pant* Hrgh... Hrgh...
Why...do I...have to do this?

Now's not the time to use your head!
Now's the time to move your body!
*pant* Hrgh... Arghhh...

What's the matter? 
Slowing down already?

I...never...do push-ups...
*pant* My arms...are giving out...

Hey! Don't say that! The impossible is 
possible! All you gotta do is make it so!
<CLT=cltMIND>What the...? That logic makes no sense!
Hrgh... Nghhhh!

<CLT=cltMIND>Somehow I managed 50 push-ups, but my body
was spent. I collapsed on the grass, panting.
*pant...pant...*

Geez, that's pathetic, man...
Getting tired from only 50 push-ups.

Well, that's enough for now.
We'll pick back up tomorrow.
...We're doing this again tomorrow?

Huh? Well, yeah. You gotta do daily 
training every day, right?
But...why do I "gotta" do this, Kaito?
Because this training's for you...
For me...?

When I look at you...I can't help but 
get frustrated. I ask myself...

Is the one Kaede entrusted her wish to 
really this weak?

You've been holding yourself back 
since <CLT=cltSTRONG>then<CLT=cltNORMAL>...haven't you?

Do you think Kaede died because you made 
a wrong deduction? Do you think you killed her?

Yes. I do, Kaito... Because of my
detective work, she set up that—

What are you saying!?
That was all her fault!
Her sins and her regrets are hers alone!

You'll only make her worry about you 
if you try to bear all those by yourself!
I...know...

I know that! I already know that!
You don't have to tell *me*!

But...I can't help it, Kaito! I can't stop myself
from thinking about what I could have done!

I'm...scared.
I try hard not to be, but I'm scared.

I can't stop thinking about...the pain and sadness
that comes if I <CLT=cltSTRONG>reveal the truth<CLT=cltNORMAL>.
That's what I'm afraid of...

Alright, I got it!
So that's your enemy, huh!?
Enemy?

Well, you gotta deal with your worries yourself.
I can't give you an answer for those, but...

At least you know you're weak.
As long as you can admit that...

Then you'll be okay!
You just gotta train and get stronger!
Huh?

Listen up! Training is the only way to
overcome your weakness.

Ah, but, in my case, getting "<CLT=cltSTRONG>stronger<CLT=cltNORMAL>"
is more of a mental concept...

Your head and body are connected, right?
At the end of the day, they're the same!

<CLT=cltMIND>...What does that even mean?
He's not making any sense...

<CLT=cltMIND>But maybe...that's exactly what
I need right now.
Alright, Kaito. I'll try.

Ah, I mean, will you let me?
I want to train with you, Kaito.
To get closer to defeating my enemy.

Well said, bro! But I'm strict, so you 
better prepare yourself!

<CLT=cltMIND>"Bro," huh?
That's the first time he's called me that...

But, ah...perhaps you should
be training too, Kaito.
You talk big for a guy that only did 20 push-ups...
Wha—! You were counting!?

Geez, you even noticed that. I guess you
are the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Detective<CLT=cltNORMAL>, after all.

But, y'know, the goal was just 50 anyway,
so it doesn't matter if I'm a few short!
<CLT=cltMIND>Well that's not fair at all...

<CLT=cltMIND>And thus, Kaito and I began
our training regimen.

<CLT=cltMIND>I don't really know why Kaito
is so concerned about me...

<CLT=cltMIND>But I suppose I can trust 
someone again. Just this time.
<CLT=cltMIND>I decided to trust Kaito.

<CLT=cltMIND>I decided to trust Kaito
and his craziness.
Nyeh? Oh, it's you, Shuichi...
What are you doing up at this hour?

Nyeeeh...
Well, just thinking.

But it's pretty late now.
Hmm, I think I'll sleep well tonight.

If I knew it'd be like this...I woulda had her
undo my brainwashing a long time ago.
...Your brainwashing?
Well, good night...

<CLT=cltMIND>What was that about...? She looked happier
than usual, I wonder what happened.

Huh? Shuichi?
Where are you off to at this hour?

Ah, well, I have...something to do...
What are *you* doing?
Oh, I was just praying to Atua, annnnd...
Nyahahaha! Just be excited for tomorrow!
Tomorrow...?

Good night, Shuichi!
See you tomorrow!

<CLT=cltMIND>Tomorrow?
Is she planning something...?

<CLT=cltMIND>When I used the item, the vine suddenly
withered... How does that work?

<CLT=cltMIND>That door I can see over there must
lead somewhere into the school...
<CLT=cltMIND>Where could it lead?
<CLT=cltMIND>So this is the key to the gate...
